summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: tslint-folder-schema@1.0.12 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/...`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's it, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [<path to math_init.js>], {stdio:'inherit'})` to execute the shipped sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, string-array shuffle via `WV8StW` rotating a large mixed constant table, `_0x`-style identifier renaming) that is not referenced by the declared library entry `lib/folderSchemaRule.js` and only reachable through the preinstall→Bun path — the payload is designed to run under an alternate runtime so Node-based static analysis cannot reason about it. package.json also impersonates an unrelated organization: name is `tslint-folder-schema` but homepage and repository point at `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, and the visible library code mirrors that project's tslint rule as cover. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape, opaque obfuscated payload, and metadata impersonation together are the install-time-RCE fingerprint: installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled, non-inspectable code with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
